notes.title: Launch issue has been sorted out.
notes.content:
Hi dear friends,

This patch fixes the issue with the library DirectX absence on some PCs. Due to which some users were unable to launch the game.

We apologize for the inconveniences caused by the last update!
Thankfully, now you'll be able to launch the portal, set out to help the elves which have left the island and play through new exciting levels! 
There will be a new type of daily quests that can be taken up over and over again.

We appreciate your help in resolving this matter.

Kind regards,
FIVE-BN Team

notes.title: Update is available
notes.content:
Hi folks,

With this update the following were done:
- fixed [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/435030/discussions/0/385428458170358751] Bugged/broken Quest: Magnetic Quest [/url]
- Decreased amount of necessary crystals (from 400 to 100) to spend at the beginnnig for Oligarch achievement
- fixed bug when users may see window with sale offer with empty content
- some minor fixes

Thank you for your interest to this game. 
We are happy to know that you like to play it.
